headline: DETAILS REVEALED on the increase of Croatian veterans' pensions: Who gets it and who doesn't
summary: Pensions will rise for 201,304 people, more than 70 percent of all veterans, according to Medved. He said the share is much larger than Možemo had requested earlier.
why: Pension increases are a recurring fiscal cost for the state budget, which affects government borrowing and public spending plans.
